caption: The drawing depicts a single, cylindrical jar with a slightly rounded shoulder and an open mouth. The jar is rendered in a uniform light brown color, suggestive of unglazed clay or stoneware, with subtle shading and variations in tone to indicate texture and contour. The rim of the jar is darker, with a prominent thick band that appears brownish-black, possibly indicating glazing or residue around the inner edge. There are minor marks and imperfections visible on the surface of the jar, contributing to its realistic appearance. The background is a plain, off-white or cream color with no additional objects or scenery present. The composition centers the jar vertically and horizontally within the frame, focusing sole attention on the vessel itself.
